entry.title: New: dsh-wallpaper-engine
entry.summary: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders. Exact install spec: github:ruijiaang-lab/dsh-wallpaper-engine. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
